subject.title: [Feature]: Audio file support in read tool (multimodal parity with images)

question: Should OpenClaw add native audio content blocks to the read-tool/LLM/provider contract, or keep read text/image-only and route audio through existing transcription/media-understanding paths?
rationale: The implementation requires maintainer intent on raw media egress, provider capability routing, Codex compatibility, transcript/session representation, and unsupported-model fallback semantics.

options.title: Design shared native-audio contract first
options.body: Add audio only after the typed content block, provider serialization, limits, security policy, and transcript behavior are specified and tested.

options.title: Fold into #51667
options.body: Treat read-tool audio as a subtask of the broader native-audio tracker, but keep this issue linked until that tracker explicitly covers local read() behavior.

options.title: Keep read text/image-only
options.body: Document that local audio should use media-understanding or transcription workflows instead of read-tool native attachments.

recommendation.title: Design shared native-audio contract first
recommendation.body: Add audio only after the typed content block, provider serialization, limits, security policy, and transcript behavior are specified and tested.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter carries the current read/LLM/media files and has the strongest recent history on the affected media contract boundary.
